quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 net sales were JPY 121.7 billion, -10.3% year-on-year; operating income JPY 14.3 billion, -41.1% year-on-year at an 11.8% OP margin; net income JPY 10.4 billion. SPE segment sales were JPY 93 billion (-16% YoY, 76.5% of total) with a 15.4% OP margin, as China/Taiwan foundry and logic sales declined - management said this was within expectation and driven solely by the sales drop. A delayed China memory project will be posted in the second quarter: probability higher than 90% (final auditor confirmation pending) and about half of the expected sales already shipped as of the call. China fell to 27% of sales from 41%, while EU rose to 16%, Taiwan to 23%. Despite the weak quarter, record-high orders were received.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 net sales JPY 121.7 billion (-10.3% YoY); OP JPY 14.3 billion (-41.1% YoY), margin 11.8%; net income JPY 10.4 billion; SPE sales JPY 93 billion (-16% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Full-year FY2027 forecast raised: net sales JPY 743 billion (from JPY 725 billion in the May forecast), operating income JPY 156.5 billion (from JPY 150 billion), net income JPY 115 billion (from JPY 110 billion). SPE segment sales raised to JPY 620 billion (+JPY 20 billion from May) with operating income of JPY 159 billion (from JPY 153 billion) at a 25.6% OP margin. Annual dividend raised from JPY 175 to a record JPY 183. The order book for this fiscal year's sales is almost fixed; the second half runs at or near full capacity with the fourth quarter higher than the third. SCREEN will outperform WFE market growth. Post-sales will exceed JPY 100 billion for the first time this fiscal year.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 net sales JPY 743 billion (raised from JPY 725 billion); OP JPY 156.5 billion; SPE sales JPY 620 billion, SPE OP JPY 159 billion (25.6% margin); dividend JPY 183; post-sales above JPY 100 billion

quarterly_data.signal: WFE is expected to grow about 20% in calendar 2026 and a similar level in calendar 2027. Updated CY2026 growth by application: advanced logic foundry over 20%, DRAM over 25% (raised), NAND about 20% (raised from a bit less than 15%), power devices a bit less than 10%. Foundry AI-driven leading edge investment is the primary WFE driver; advanced DRAM and HBM are in shortage and even existing DDR is in shortage, so CapEx is going into both HBM and general DDR, with strong NAND investment also expected as data center demand recovers. Memory device makers are asking for accelerated delivery - demand is now stronger than SCREEN's current capacity. Average equipment lead time is about 4.2 months. Chinese demand for advanced AI-related tools is at record-high inquiry levels.
quarterly_data.figure: WFE about 20% growth in calendar 2026 and 2027; DRAM over 25%, NAND about 20%, advanced logic foundry over 20%; lead time 4.2 months; demand stronger than capacity

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity for this fiscal year and next is already secured, with remodeling underway at Nagaoka and Kyoto (complete at the beginning of next fiscal year) and capacity measures at Hikone; currently expected market growth for this and next fiscal year plus alpha is covered by current capacity. Advanced packaging: WLP applications lead initially, followed by growth in PLP applications; the PLP evaluation-phase market is expected to roughly double next fiscal year. SCREEN joined the Applied Materials EPIC Center in California as an innovation partner, and the ATCA U.S. R&D hub evaluation process is being established. Pricing: improved equipment performance and higher raw material costs are being reflected into prices, and customers are increasingly accepting the adjustments.
quarterly_data.figure: Nagaoka and Kyoto capacity expansion complete at the beginning of next fiscal year; PLP market expected to double next fiscal year
